package main

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "sort"
 "strings"
 lint "zabaplint"
)

type object struct { Type, Name string }
func main() {
 var input struct { Files []lint.File; Config string }
 raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1]); if err != nil { panic(err) }
 if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &input); err != nil { panic(err) }
 var checker lint.Checker
 checker.Prime(input.Files, nil, input.Config)
 // Derive registry identities from filenames, then let CheckObject establish
 // existence (excluded and unknown objects are omitted, as in the Node oracle).
 objects := map[object]bool{}
 for _, f := range input.Files {
  parts := strings.Split(f.Filename[strings.LastIndex(f.Filename,"/")+1:], ".")
  if len(parts)<3 { continue }
  name := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.ReplaceAll(strings.ToUpper(parts[0]), "%23", "/"), "#", "/")
  objects[object{strings.ToUpper(parts[1]),name}] = true
 }
 ordered := make([]object,0,len(objects))
 for obj := range objects { ordered=append(ordered,obj) }
 sort.Slice(ordered,func(i,j int)bool { return ordered[i].Type+"\x00"+ordered[i].Name < ordered[j].Type+"\x00"+ordered[j].Name })
 encoder := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
 for _, obj := range ordered {
  files,found := checker.Tree(obj.Type,obj.Name)
  if !found { continue }
  concat := make([][]string,0,len(files))
  for _, f := range files {
   statements := make([]string,0,len(f.Statements))
   for _, statement := range f.Statements { statements=append(statements,lint.ConcatTokens(statement.Tokens)) }
   concat=append(concat,statements)
  }
  issues,found := checker.CheckObject(obj.Type,obj.Name)
  if !found { panic("object disappeared") }
  err = encoder.Encode(struct {Type,Name string; Found bool; Files []lint.FileTree; Concat [][]string; Issues []lint.Issue}{obj.Type,obj.Name,found,files,concat,issues})
  if err != nil { panic(err) }
 }
}
